summary: Complaints centre on sugar mill cane dues, Khekra land acquisition, health and bus services; farmers' views on power and fertiliser are inference only.

positives.english: Malakpur, Baghpat and Ramala sugar mills have paid farmers' cane dues in full
positives.hindi: मलकपुर, बागपत और रामला मिलों ने किसानों का पूरा गन्ना बकाया दे दिया
positives.basis: Amar Ujala (12 Oct 2026, re-opened): 'बागपत की तीनों चीनी मिलों ने किसानों का संपूर्ण भुगतान कर दिया है'; the article names the three as Malakpur, Baghpat and Ramala. The same article says Kinauni and Bhainsana mills still owe (see N1) and are not among the three. District-level; AC membership of the mills not confirmed.

positives.english: * Sugarcane payments are coming on time now
positives.hindi: * गन्ने का भुगतान अब समय पर मिलने लगा है
positives.basis: Inference: the Aaj Tak 26 Sep 2026 Baghpat farmers' ground report appears to say payments are now timely, but the page returned 403 and could not be read, so no source is cited. District-level.

positives.english: * Fertiliser no longer means long queues like before
positives.hindi: * खाद के लिए अब पहले जैसी लंबी लाइन नहीं लगानी पड़ती
positives.basis: Inference: the Aaj Tak 26 Sep 2026 Baghpat ground report is reported to say this, but the page could not be opened, so no source is cited. District-level.

positives.english: * Power for irrigation has improved somewhat
positives.hindi: * सिंचाई के लिए बिजली अब पहले से कुछ बेहतर मिल रही है
positives.basis: Inference: the Aaj Tak 26 Sep 2026 Baghpat ground report is reported to say this, but the page could not be opened, so no source is cited. District-level.

positives.english: * Farmers no longer feel the same fear of going to fields at night
positives.hindi: * रात में खेत पर जाने का पहले जैसा डर नहीं रहा
positives.basis: Inference: the Aaj Tak 26 Sep 2026 Baghpat ground report is reported to say this, but the page could not be opened, so no source is cited. District-level.

negatives.english: Kinauni mill still owes ₹20 crore and Bhainsana mill ₹9 crore in cane dues
negatives.hindi: किनौनी मिल पर 20 करोड़, भैंसाना पर 9 करोड़ बकाया है
negatives.basis: Amar Ujala (12 Oct 2026): Kinauni mill owes ₹20 crore and Bhainsana mill ₹9 crore; the district cane officer issued notices to clear dues within a week; the two mills are not showing interest in paying. District-level. AC membership of Kinauni and Bhainsana unconfirmed.

negatives.english: Land acquisition for an industrial area in 12 Khekra villages, farmers want 4x compensation
negatives.hindi: खेकड़ा में 12 गांवों की जमीन का अधिग्रहण, चार गुना मुआवजा चाहिए
negatives.basis: Univarta (25 Aug 2026): land acquisition of 12 villages for a proposed industrial area in the Khekra area; farmers insist on four times market rate; SDM-chaired meeting ended without agreement and the demand is to be forwarded to the state government. Khekra tehsil is in the AC per Wikipedia extent. ETV Bharat (7 Jun 2026) reports the same four-times demand for a 2,000 ha UPSIDA corridor with a mahapanchayat of 12 villages; it does not name Khekra or any tehsil, and its villages (Lahchauda, Sarfabad, Garhi Kalanjari) are not confirmed inside the AC.

negatives.english: 23 doctors missing in Baghpat district, Khekra and Baghpat CHCs short-staffed
negatives.hindi: बागपत में 23 डॉक्टर लापता हैं, सीएचसी में इलाज की दिक्कत है
negatives.basis: Amar Ujala (15 Sep 2026): '47 चिकित्सकों की कमी' and '23 चिकित्सक लापता' in the district; doctors listed missing from Khekra CHC and Baghpat CHC; 'लोगों को स्वास्थ्य सेवाएं नहीं मिल पा रहीं'. District-level, with the two named CHCs inside the AC (Khekra tehsil; Baghpat CHC in Baghpat town).

negatives.english: Hours-long waits at Baghpat bus stand on Raksha Bandhan, passengers forced to hang onto vehicles
negatives.hindi: बागपत बस अड्डे पर घंटों इंतजार, लोग लटककर सफर करने को मजबूर
negatives.basis: Amar Ujala (29 Aug 2026): on Raksha Bandhan, buses could not be found at the Bawli Chungi bus stand in Baghpat, passengers waited for hours and were forced onto daggamar vehicles; a passenger said 'इनमें भी जगह नहीं मिल रही है'. Baghpat town (Baghpat MB) is inside the AC per Wikipedia extent.

negatives.english: 15-hour power cut stopped water supply, villagers crowd handpumps
negatives.hindi: 15 घंटे बिजली गई, पानी के लिए हैंडपंपों पर भीड़ लगी
negatives.basis: Amar Ujala (6 Sep 2026), dateline Ratol: power stopped for 15 hours in Pooranpur Nawada and Garhi Kalanjari; drinking water supply stopped, women crowded government handpumps, residents protested. Ratol and these villages are not named in the AC extent, so AC membership is unconfirmed; district-level only.

round2.changes: Removed 4 Aaj Tak source entries (URL returned 403, not readable; search snippet did not confirm fertiliser or night-fear claims). Positives 2-5 converted to flagged inference. Positive 1 is now the sourced mills-paid-in-full item. Negative 1 restated as Kinauni 20 cr and Bhainsana 9 cr (the 29 cr total was our sum, removed). Negative 2 now cites Univarta as primary with ETV as supporting (ETV does not name Khekra). Negative 3 names both CHCs and the 47/23 figures. Negative 4 dropped the unverified Tatiri mention and the misquoted passenger line. Negative 5 kept as district-level with AC membership unconfirmed. Rejected sources: Doula CHC (2022, tehsil unknown), construction report (projects not started), Ratol power-cut villages not confirmed in AC.

notes: AC-052 voice pass: P1 and N1 both come from the Amar Ujala 12 Oct 2026 article (re-opened). That article says the three mills (Malakpur, Baghpat, Ramala) have paid in full and that Kinauni (Rs 20 crore) and Bhainsana (Rs 9 crore) still owe, so both are kept and P1 now names its three mills to show they are not Kinauni or Bhainsana. Whether the three mills sit inside AC 52 was not checked; AC membership unconfirmed.
